timeline.body:
This PR adds missing call to clear last successful authentication cache,
when clear all realm cache action is called.

Fixes #86650

timeline.body: Hi @slobodanadamovic, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Nit: The `TransportClearRealmCacheAction` itself is a real object, not a mock. So I'd call this method `createClearRealmCacheAction`. Or just simply inline this method.
Can't we just mock the `CachingRealm` interface?

reply.body:
Unfortunately, we can't. Reason is because `Realms` hold `Realm` objects not `CachingRealm`. 
I thought of using `CachingUsernamePasswordRealm` instead, but this abstract class has made `expire` and `expireAll` methods final. Hence why I decided to introduce `TestCachingRealm`. I'm not super happy about it, but I did not see other options.
All good. Thanks for the explanation.

timeline.body:
I think we can random from either empty string array or null, e.g.
```suggestion
        final String[] realmsToClear = randomFrom(Strings.EMPTY_ARRAY, null);
```

Same applies to other empty realm/user array
We could also assert `expireAll` is not called.
Same here, negative assertion for `expireAll` could be helpful.
